report.summary: NOT A DRIVER SEAM -- the driver's other_floor answer is honest: the game's own client cannot press a plane-0 loc from plane 1 either (the pick drops it, and an oploc names only x,z, resolved on the player's plane). Reproduced (build/quest_gate/ofl_seam, probe.lua): from the course start 2643,4034,1 click_loc peng_agility_steps01 -> FAIL other_floor (loc at 2635,4054,0), stepstone01 -> other_floor (2631,4057,0), crusher press -> 'no copy in the npc pool' (crushers spawn on plane 0). From plane 0 the same Ice steps climbs first time (proof row 4: 'teleport: 2634,4054,0 -> 2634,4054,1'). The Cold War course is blocked by three things below the driver: (1) ENGINE: torirs_server_scene.c terrain_is_ocean() counts overlay 537 (the course's wading water, (537-442)%3==2) as ocean and ocean_blocks_walk blocks every water tile, so a player in the water cannot walk one tile (walk_to 2633,4054 from 2634,4054,0 timed out in place) and stepstone01 refuses 'I can't reach that!' even from the adjacent 2630,4056,0; (2) CONTENT: nothing takes the player from the guide's start tile 2636,4054,1 (QH agilityEnterWater) down into the plane-0 water (QH zone inAgilityWater 2628-2635,4053-4065,0) -- the mechanism is unsourced; and the crusher npcs 856-859 have no ops in all.npc (menu shows only 'Examine Crusher'), so penguin_course.rs2's [opnpc1,crushblock*] can never fire -- wiki says the crusher is passed by timing a walk past it; (3) stone 7 (2635,4065,1, a walkable tile) refuses 'I can't reach that!' from stone 6 at 2635,4063 while stones 1-6 jump fine (probe4 rows 2-12) -- a server reach decision on a real click. The DoH shelf (myq3_agil_26_shelf_climb_down at 3626,3221,2) is NOT reproducible: it presses first time from 3625,3221,2 -> 3626,3221,1 (proof row 7), matching QH's path. The one change: pointer.lua's other_floor detail and banner now say the client cannot press it either and name the plane to reach ('reach level N by the guide's route first (a missing route is a content seam, not a driver one)'), so the next triage does not file it as a driver seam.
report.verified_by: run.py --script build/seam_state/vm-b1-seam1/ofl/proof.lua --name ofl_seam --no-build --no-publish -> SUMMARY 8 PASS pass=8 fail=0: row 2 ice-steps.from-level1 'not_visible other_floor: peng_agility_steps01 has no copy a press on level 1 can pick -- nearest 2635,4054 is on level 0 ... -- the game's client cannot press it from here either: reach level 0 by the guide's route first'; row 4 ice-steps.from-level0 'teleport: 2634,4054,0 -> 2634,4054,1'; row 7 doh-shelf-climb-down 'teleport: 3625,3221,2 -> 3626,3221,1'; PNGs 002/004/007 read (player on the iceberg edge, then in/at the course water; DoH Meiyerditch rooftops). Reproduction before the edit: probe.lua row 3 FAIL other_floor (same verdict, old wording), probes 2-4 for the water/stone diagnosis (ledgers overwritten under the one --name; quoted in the notebook). Regressions: run.py cooks_assistant --no-build --no-publish 48/0 gate green; druid 30/0 gate green; make -C src check-drive-abi PASS, check-pt-switch PASS. No C change, so no binary rebuild. No committed test/quests/coldwar.lua or darknessofhallowvale.lua exists, so there was no committed file to copy and drive past a t.blocked.
